2020-03-12.event_on_day_desc: WHO declared COVID-19 a global pandemic (Mar 11); US President Trump announced Europe travel ban; global markets in historic freefall — NIFTY -8.30%, Dow -9.99%
2020-03-12.global_signal_desc: Dow Jones -9.99%, NIFTY -8.30%, global circuit breakers triggered; worst single-day drops since 1987
2020-03-12.analyst_note: The session's extreme behaviour is fully explained by contemporaneous global pandemic news and falls outside any surveillance-priority concern.

2021-12-16.macro_window_desc: RBI MPC Dec 8 decision (repo rate held at 4.0%, accommodative stance) fell within the 10-day macro window; Omicron variant concerns; US Fed taper signal
2021-12-16.global_signal_desc: Omicron COVID variant uncertainty and US Federal Reserve tapering signals drove global volatility through December 2021
2021-12-16.analyst_note: Unusual final-bar behaviour warrants inspection; no listed event on day but macro context (RBI hold +8 days, Omicron) partially explains elevated volatility.

2022-03-10.macro_window_desc: US CPI Feb 2022 at 7.9% (40-year high) released on Mar 10; US Fed rate hike of 25bps on Mar 16 signaled; Indian state election results (BJP victory UP) announced in this window
2022-03-10.analyst_note: High-T settlement-window activity partly explained by macro release (US CPI) and state election political catalyst driving intraday repositioning.

2022-03-24.macro_window_desc: First US Federal Reserve rate hike of 25bps on Mar 16 (8 days prior); Russia-Ukraine war ongoing; Brent crude >$130 per barrel
2022-03-24.global_signal_desc: Russia-Ukraine war causing global commodity shock; FII outflows from India; crude oil spike above $130
2022-03-24.analyst_note: Elevated MIRS in a period of genuine macro uncertainty; US Fed tightening and geopolitical risk are legitimate explanations to test first.

2023-01-25.event_on_day_desc: Hindenburg Research published short-seller report on Adani Group (Jan 24); Adani Group formal response Jan 25; massive selloff in Adani stocks, India VIX spike
2023-01-25.analyst_note: Listed event (Hindenburg/Adani) explains the session; this is a negative control demonstrating the news discount works mechanically.

2023-07-06.macro_window_desc: NSE circular (Jun 6) changed Bank Nifty weekly expiry from Thursday to Friday effective Jul 7 — structural market change but not a macro release; NIFTY 50 near all-time high 19,400+
2023-07-06.analyst_note: No catalogued macro or global explanation; high-MIRS behaviour on this expiry lacks a contemporaneous public information trigger. Highest residual surveillance priority in the dataset.

2023-11-16.global_signal_desc: Softer US CPI (Oct 2023) released ~Nov 14 triggered US Fed pivot optimism; global bond yields fell; risk-on rally worldwide; NIFTY +0.46%, IT sector +2.5%
2023-11-16.analyst_note: Global risk-on from US inflation data partially explains elevated settlement activity; surveillance priority remains elevated as T=0.80.

2023-12-21.global_signal_desc: US Fed dovish pivot at Dec 2023 FOMC (signaled rate cuts); global equity rally followed by profit-booking; NIFTY volatile, closed +0.50% above 21,250
2023-12-21.analyst_note: Global Fed pivot spillover explains part of the session's unusual volatility pattern; MIRS=0.70 (Green tier) warrants monitoring.

2024-02-01.event_on_day_desc: India Interim Union Budget presented by FM Nirmala Sitharaman on Feb 1 2024; coincided with NIFTY weekly options expiry. Market reaction muted (NIFTY -0.13%) as interim budget was non-event policy-wise. IV crush post-speech squeezed options premiums sharply. Paytm Payments Bank RBI action caused intraday stock volatility.
2024-02-01.analyst_note: Listed event (Interim Union Budget) dominates the session narrative. Volatility crush post-budget is a known mechanical effect; NES discount applied. Included as negative control.

2024-03-28.macro_window_desc: Triple coincidence: monthly expiry + quarterly expiry + last trading day of FY2023-24. Nifty +0.92% to 22,326. FY24 annual gain ~29%. NSE Bank Nifty shifted monthly expiry to Wednesdays from Mar 2024; this is Nifty 50's last Thursday monthly expiry of that quarter.
2024-03-28.analyst_note: Triple-witching structural event (monthly + quarterly + FY end) on the same day is a known volatility amplifier. Elevated MIRS plausibly attributed to end-of-year institutional repositioning rather than anomalous behaviour.

2024-04-18.macro_window_desc: RBI MPC Apr 5 2024 (repo rate held 6.50%, 7th consecutive pause); Indian General Elections Phase 1 voting began Apr 19 — just one day after expiry, creating pre-election positioning pressure. Israel-Iran conflict escalation drove global headwinds. Nifty -0.69% to 21,995.
2024-04-18.global_signal_desc: Middle East geopolitical tensions (Israel-Iran conflict) escalated; FII outflows; weak global cues depressed Indian markets on expiry day
2024-04-18.analyst_note: Highest MIRS in walk-forward sample (0.74, Orange). Pre-election positioning (elections start next day) combined with Middle East risk and RBI policy stability create a plausible macro narrative, but residual anomaly remains after discounting.

2024-09-12.macro_window_desc: Within Fed blackout period ahead of Sep 17-18 2024 FOMC (first rate cut of easing cycle expected; 50bps jumbo cut speculation); FPI inflow optimism for India. Nifty +1.89% to 25,388 — broad-based short-covering rally on expiry day.
2024-09-12.global_signal_desc: Global markets pricing in US Fed easing cycle start; risk-on rally in EMs including India; FPI inflows ahead of FOMC
2024-09-12.analyst_note: Second-highest MIRS in walk-forward sample (0.72, Orange). Unusually strong expiry-day rally (+1.89%) in a Fed blackout window. Pre-FOMC positioning partially explains the pattern but magnitude of settlement-window move warrants inspection.

2025-04-30.macro_window_desc: RBI MPC Apr 7-9 2025: unanimously cut repo rate by 25bps to 6.00%, shifted stance to accommodative — first RBI cut of the new easing cycle. NSE shifted NIFTY expiry from Thursday to Monday effective Apr 4 2025 — first Monday-expiry monthly settlement.
2025-04-30.global_signal_desc: US trade policy uncertainties and shifting global supply-chain dynamics created intermittent equity corrections offsetting RBI tailwinds
2025-04-30.analyst_note: Top T=1.00 monthly expiry. Double structural novelty: RBI easing cycle start (25bps cut, accommodative) plus first-ever Monday expiry settlement for NIFTY. These dual catalysts likely drove repositioning; surveillance priority remains for the residual portion.

2025-05-08.macro_window_desc: US Fed FOMC concluded May 7 2025 (rate held 4.25-4.50%); dovish tone provided initial tailwind for EMs. India-Pakistan geopolitical tensions on May 8 caused intraday VIX spike ~10% to 18.4-18.5; Nifty closed lower on selling pressure.
2025-05-08.global_signal_desc: Post-FOMC global risk-on initially, reversed by India-Pakistan geopolitical tensions on May 8; India VIX spiked ~10%; FII activity volatile
2025-05-08.analyst_note: Top T=1.00 weekly expiry. Post-FOMC tailwind collided with India-Pakistan tensions on the exact expiry day, creating sharp intraday reversal. The geopolitical shock on expiry day itself is a contemporaneous public catalyst, partially explaining unusual patterns.

2025-05-22.global_signal_desc: US fiscal concerns (debt/spending bill projections) pushed Treasury yields to multi-month highs; FII outflows weakened INR to ~86 vs USD. Nifty -0.82% to 24,609; broad-based sell-off across Auto, IT, FMCG, Oil & Gas.
2025-05-22.analyst_note: Green tier but included for coverage. Global US fiscal risk spillover on expiry day explains directional pressure; settlement-window residual portion warrants secondary monitoring.

2025-06-19.macro_window_desc: RBI MPC Jun 4-6 2025 cut repo rate aggressively by 50bps to 5.50% — surprise stimulus. US Fed FOMC Jun 17-18 2025 kept rates unchanged at 4.25-4.50% with neutral tone. Both central bank outcomes delivered within 2 weeks of this expiry.
2025-06-19.global_signal_desc: Post-FOMC US rate-hold (hawkish/neutral) one day before expiry; global mixed signals from divergent RBI-easing vs Fed-pausing policy stance
2025-06-19.analyst_note: RBI 50bps cut (surprise size) within 15 days is a strong macro_window trigger. US Fed hold delivered the day before this expiry. The divergence of RBI easing vs Fed pausing is a significant structural backdrop explaining repositioning.

2026-06-23.macro_window_desc: RBI MPC Jun 3-5 2026 kept repo rate unchanged at 5.25% with neutral stance, flagging monsoon and energy risks. US Fed FOMC Jun 16-17 2026 (dot-plot release) occurred one week before expiry, with global rate trajectory discussion active.
2026-06-23.global_signal_desc: Post-FOMC global market digestion; FPI flows responding to RBI Fully Accessible Route adjustments; range-bound technical structure 23,800-24,200 indicating pre-expiry caution
2026-06-23.analyst_note: Most recent expiry in dataset (Jun 2026). Both RBI and US Fed delivered within the macro window. Market in range-bound consolidation; surveillance priority comes from MIRS=1.00 (top-ranked T score) rather than clear news trigger. Requires most cautious interpretation given recency.
